turns.query: What are the must-see attractions in Da Nang, such as the Dragon Bridge?
turns.asr_transcript: What are the must-see attractions in Da Nang, such as the Dragon Bridge?
turns.agent_answer: Must-sees include Dragon Bridge, Ba Na Hills with the Golden Bridge, Son Tra,Lady Buddha, and Hoi An Ancient Town!

turns.query: How can I travel from the airport to the city center?
turns.asr_transcript: Wait, can I use Grab at the airport?
turns.agent_answer: Yes,Grab rides are available right outside arrivals at Da Nang International Airport. It is very convenient!
